text:
neha: Heads-up — aiming to ship AtlasFlow in Q2. Need cross-team alignment on sequencing + showstoppers. Can we map dependencies for runtime/infra/security and decide minimal launch scope?
ryan: We need to redesign prefix caching for AtlasFlow's long context. Right now it causes KV thrash at 4k tokens. Estimate: 2 full sprints for a safe refactor, or 3 x smaller spikes and a follow-up.
tara: Infra needs reserved GPU slots + egress rules for the new data plane. If product wants burst, we'll need a capacity commit or we'll autoscale on shared and it will be noisy. Numbers: baseline 4 GPU hours/sec, peak 12.
dave: Security: KMS integration + audit logging for private deploys. Also request for threat model review and a small penetration test before canary for customer A. That adds ~3 weeks.
lily: To unblock, what if we scope Phase 1 to "AtlasFlow-lite" — no long-context caching, reduced prefetch, single-region hosted only. That should cut runtime work in half.
mike: We can ship lite using current runtime with higher token costs and a degraded batching profile. Works as a temporary fallback; will need ops docs for SLOs.
neha: OK — product preference is unblock fast for early adopters while we iterate on caching. Proposed plan: Phase 1 (lite hosted) -> canary -> Phase 2 (full caching + multi-region). Need owners and dates.
ryan: Owner: runtime caching = Ryan. I'll set up a spec doc but need a clear acceptance test set. Product please provide 10 representative prompts + perf targets.
neha: Sending test corpus by EOD. Acceptance: tail latency P95 < 300ms for short convs, P95 < 800ms for long-context (with degraded batching), cost per 1k tokens target <= $0.35.
tara: For Phase 1 hosted-only we can reserve capacity in us-west-2 by next sprint if we get a sign-off today. Need PO to OK monthly commit.
dave: Security can run a focused review in parallel if product confirms customers and data types. KMS + audit logs must be in the plan for Phase 2. For Phase 1 we'll accept reduced audit retention (30d) as negotiation.
lily: Noted. Product signs off on commit for reserve if we can deliver canary in 4 weeks.
mike: Ops/action item: I'll draft runbook for degraded batching + manual rollback steps. @ryan can you add runtime feature flags for cache off/on?
ryan: Yes, I'll add a feature flag and a canary rollout path (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Also adding a metrics gate: increase in token cost > 20% triggers rollback.
neha: Great. Quick checklist I want captured: 1) product test corpus (NEHA) 2) runtime feature flag + spec (RYAN) 3) infra reserve + networking (TARA) 4) security review + KMS plan (DAVE) 5) ops runbook (MIKE). Target: canary start in 4 weeks, full Phase 1 in 6.
deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: looks like 4 blockers: infra commit missing, security ack missing, runtime feature-flag PR not opened, test corpus not uploaded.
neha: I'll upload corpus and confirm commit by EOD. Ryan/Tara/Dave — please post owner updates by tomorrow noon.
ryan: Will open PR today and link spec.
tara: Pinged finance for commit, will update here when we get confirmation.
dave: Starting threat-model doc, will flag any issues.
lily: :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll run weekly sync until Phase 1 is stable.
